title: Compatible Artinian lifts through an isomorphism of completions
statement: Let $\varphi:A\to B$ be a local homomorphism of nonzero commutative Noetherian local rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], with maximal ideals $\mathfrak m_A,\mathfrak m_B$. Here a ring is local when it has a unique maximal ideal, and a homomorphism is local when the inverse image of the target maximal ideal is the source maximal ideal. Write $i_A:A\to\widehat A$, $i_B:B\to\widehat B$ for their maximal-ideal completion maps [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], and $\pi_{A,n}:\widehat A\to A/\mathfrak m_A^n$, $\pi_{B,n}:\widehat B\to B/\mathfrak m_B^n$ for the coordinate projections. Suppose the coordinatewise map $h:\widehat A\to\widehat B$ induced by $\varphi$ is an isomorphism. Let $q:C'\twoheadrightarrow C$ be a surjective homomorphism of nonzero commutative Artinian local rings (every descending chain of ideals stabilizes), and let $a:A\to C'$ and $b:B\to C$ be local homomorphisms with $qa=b\varphi$. There exist $r,s\ge1$ with $\mathfrak m_{C'}^r=0$, $\mathfrak m_C^s=0$, and factorizations $a=\bar a\circ(A\to A/\mathfrak m_A^r)$ and $b=\bar b\circ(B\to B/\mathfrak m_B^s)$. For any such $r,s$, set $\widehat a=\bar a\pi_{A,r}$ and $\widehat b=\bar b\pi_{B,s}$. These satisfy $\widehat a i_A=a$, $\widehat b i_B=b$, kill $(\mathfrak m_A\widehat A)^r$ and $(\mathfrak m_B\widehat B)^s$, respectively, and obey $q\widehat a=\widehat b h$. The homomorphism $c=\widehat a h^{-1}i_B:B\to C'$ is local and satisfies $qc=b$ and $c\varphi=a$.

source.place: Tag 0CAV (lemma-isomorphism-approximation), first proof paragraph: compatible Artinian local-ring lifts through the inverse completed stalk map implicit in the smoothness assertion; algebraic sublemma, not a verbatim statement of the tag.

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-artinian-local-noetherian-nilpotent] to $C'$ and $C$ to obtain $r,s\ge1$ with $\mathfrak m_{C'}^r=0$ and $\mathfrak m_C^s=0$. Locality gives $a(\mathfrak m_A)\subseteq\mathfrak m_{C'}$ and $b(\mathfrak m_B)\subseteq\mathfrak m_C$. Consequently $a$ kills $\mathfrak m_A^r$ and $b$ kills $\mathfrak m_B^s$: a generator of either power is a product of the indicated number of elements of the maximal ideal, and its image is zero. Thus $\bar a([x])=a(x)$ and $\bar b([y])=b(y)$ are well-defined ring homomorphisms giving the required factorizations.

source.place: Tag 00J8 (lemma-artinian-radical-nilpotent); quotient factorization written out for the lifting argument implicit in Tag 0CAV.

proof.text: Now fix any permitted $r,s$ and factorizations. By [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], the coordinate projections are ring homomorphisms and $\pi_{A,r}i_A(x)=[x]$, $\pi_{B,s}i_B(y)=[y]$. Hence $\widehat a=\bar a\pi_{A,r}$ and $\widehat b=\bar b\pi_{B,s}$ are ring homomorphisms restricting to $a,b$. The projection $\pi_{A,r}$ kills $(\mathfrak m_A\widehat A)^r$: that ideal is generated by products $i_A(x_1)\cdots i_A(x_r)$ with $x_j\in\mathfrak m_A$, whose projections are zero modulo $\mathfrak m_A^r$. Multiplying these generators by arbitrary completed coefficients and taking finite sums still projects to zero. The identical calculation for $B,s$ proves the second annihilation assertion.

source.place: Section Tag 00M9 (section-completion), compatible-sequence construction; elementary calculation with the coordinate ring homomorphisms.

proof.text: For $z\in\widehat A$, set $t=\max(r,s)$ and choose $x\in A$ representing its $t$-th coordinate. Compatibility of the sequence gives $\pi_{A,r}(z)=[x]$ and $\pi_{A,s}(z)=[x]$. By the assumed coordinatewise description of $h$, $\pi_{B,s}(h(z))=[\varphi(x)]$. Therefore $q\widehat a(z)=qa(x)=b\varphi(x)=\widehat b(h(z))$. This proves $q\widehat a=\widehat b h$ for arbitrary $r,s$, without asserting uniqueness of arbitrary ring maps out of a completion. The calculation uses only the compatible-sequence definition [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion].

source.place: Section Tag 00M9 (section-completion), elementary comparison at the single finite coordinate t; filling the Artinian compatibility implicit in Tag 0CAV.

proof.text: The same coordinate description gives $hi_A=i_B\varphi$: both maps have $n$-th coordinate $x\mapsto[\varphi(x)]$ for every $n$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Thus the ring homomorphism $c=\widehat a h^{-1}i_B$ satisfies $qc=\widehat b h h^{-1}i_B=\widehat b i_B=b$ and $c\varphi=\widehat a h^{-1}i_B\varphi=\widehat a h^{-1}hi_A=\widehat a i_A=a$.

source.place: Section Tag 00M9 (section-completion), equality of compatible sequences coordinate by coordinate; Tag 0CAV (lemma-isomorphism-approximation), implicit inverse-completion lift.

proof.text: Finally $q^{-1}(\mathfrak m_C)=\mathfrak m_{C'}$. Indeed $C'\to C/\mathfrak m_C$ is surjective since $q$ is surjective, so its kernel is a maximal ideal (its quotient is the nonzero field $C/\mathfrak m_C$), and $C'$ has exactly one maximal ideal. Taking inverse images in $qc=b$ now gives $c^{-1}(\mathfrak m_{C'})=c^{-1}q^{-1}(\mathfrak m_C)=b^{-1}(\mathfrak m_C)=\mathfrak m_B$. This is precisely the required locality of $c$.

source.place: Tag 0CAV (lemma-isomorphism-approximation), implicit local Artinian lift; elementary quotient-field and inverse-image calculation.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0CAV (lemma-isomorphism-approximation), first proof paragraph; explicit algebraic proof of the implicit compatible Artinian lift, using Algebra Tag 00J8 and the compatible-sequence definition in Section 00M9.
